title: $Θ$-reductivity and $S$-completeness for adjoint Fano foliated structures
summary: We prove the valuative criteria of $Θ$-reductivity and $S$-completeness for the moduli problem of $t$-K-semistable adjoint Fano foliated structures. We develop a mixed Ding theory for arbitrary linearly bounded multiplicative filtrations, prove inversion of adjunction with arbitrary ideals for adjoint foliated structures, and establish a relative extraction and finite generation theorem.
